avis.titre: Staple
avis.texte: Avid user all I'm From products. I leave on mask an hour plus, then dry rub it off, and rinse what's left. Sometimes I go from start to finish 1. Rice face wash 2. Rice exfoliating mask 3. Rice toner 4. Rice serum 5. Rice cream 6. Rice peel off mask overnight. Result rich glass-like Kbeauty skin. These products are leaving Ulta bc of a package redesign. I prefer the glass jar bc I can use it all, whereas the new is a plastic tube, less oz. I stocked up here while I can.

avis.titre: Good but…
avis.texte: Ive been loving this and how smooth it makes my face BUT… I just hit the halfway point of the pot and felt something sharp. At first I thought it was glass but it looked like some kind of plastic shard about and inch long. Pretty shocking!

avis.titre: Gentle but amazing
avis.texte: This face mask just blew me away. It's beyond great. It's softens skin leaves skin looking so fresh. It's so good I dont know how to properly describe it besides it makes your skin feel fresh and clean. It's very gentle. Would definitely recommend to others to try. The price is low but it does more than other expensive brands.

avis.titre: AMAZING!!!
avis.texte: I dont usually leave reviews but i have to with this product! I have been dealing with really dry skin and clogged pores. On the first use i instantly felt my skin hydrated and not feeling tight! Helped calm down my clogged pores as well. Definetly recomend!

avis.titre: UGH LOVE, LOVE, LOVE
avis.texte: My new favorite mask! Compared to others the price is much better for the about of product it contains. Plus the scent it not overpowering but rather smoothing. Easily applies and removes dead skin and leaves skin feeling clean and refreshed.

avis.titre: I love this. It smells amazing and gets rid of the dead skin

avis.titre: Over all these Rice skincare from I'm fron when used altoget
avis.texte: Skincare must be good enough to eat. 🇵‌🇷‌🇴‌🇩‌🇺‌🇨‌🇹‌ 🇷‌🇪‌🇻‌🇮‌🇪‌🇼‌ 𝔸𝕓𝕠𝕦𝕥 𝕥𝕙𝕖 𝕡𝕣𝕠𝕕𝕦𝕔𝕥 - I'm From is a K-Beauty brand that is known for its high quality plant-based ingredients and each of their skincare lines revolves around a star ingredient. 𝑅𝑒𝓋𝒾𝑒𝓌: I'M FROM RICE MASK Packaging. Comes with 110g of product stored in a thick, heavy glass jar and a plastic spatula. Texture. An off white creamy mask with grainy bits and actual rice husk. How to use. This is an exfoliator that i use atleast 2x a week. Massage on damp skin and then rinse off. I use this after the cleanser and before the toner. Before and After. It doesn't make my skin feel tight or dry after using this exfoliant. I've been free from flaky skin and gives my skin a much more clarified and brighter skin. I can definitely say that this mask guves me the result that I want. Final verdict: Over all these Rice skincare from I'm fron when used altogether can be a bit hydrating, but mostly moisturizing. It makes the skin very soft. It doesn't become sticky even when layered. Suitable for all skin types, but especially dry/flaky, combo and sensitive skin (oily skin for PM). Didn't break me out, which would probably be suitable for acne prone skin, too. #Wishtrend #WishtrendStory #Imfromglobal #klairsglobal #bywishtrend #wishtrenders #balancedby

avis.titre: Omg I really fall in love for this rice mask my skin is feel
avis.texte: Omg I really fall in love for this rice mask my skin is feel so soft and hydrated I have dry skin and this mask is so lovely and enjoyable. I so glad find this.

avis.titre: I liked this mask! the texture is perfect and it's not harsh
avis.texte: I liked this mask! the texture is perfect and it's not harsh at all. the only thing I will say is that it is a bit difficult to wash off, even in the shower, and I think they should've marketed this as a scrubbing mask and not a face mask. I was surprised to see that I don't leave this on. however I do like using this whenever my skin is a little extra congested or if I just feel like I need to scrub the day off. definitely a great product!

avis.titre: It has a very brightening, smoothening effect on my skin.
avis.texte: This mask is more of a scrub mask than a fine paste type of mask. This one is another favorite I'm From wash-off mask. I leave it on for about 10 minutes as suggested and wash off gently with water without rubbing harshly on my skin (if you have sensitive do not remove by rubbing motion) It has a very brightening, smoothening effect on my skin. It leaves my skin feeling super soft, nourished, plump, clean and bright. Absolutely love this wash off mask and a must try for Rice skincare lovers 🤍

avis.titre: This wash mask seriously does the job !
avis.texte: This wash mask seriously does the job ! Remember to apply to wet skin and gently spread on the face with your ring Finger! I let sit for 15min and honestly the rice serum with this mask are amazing!

avis.titre: remove accumulated dead skin cells and impurities for a smoo
avis.texte: This is a whitening wash-off mask containing 4.1% of rice from Yeoju. It is rich in Vitamins B1, B2, minerals and has rice water infused to gently remove accumulated dead skin cells and impurities for a smoother skin and clearer complexion. The brand has recently renewed the rice mask texture to have smaller creamier rice granules to make it less harsh physical exfoliant. I also recommend applying it on wet skin to have the best experience.

avis.titre: The best wash off mask!
avis.texte: The best wash off mask! Nourishing and exfoliating at the same time. Personally my most favorite from the brand itself. Its made up of rice bran and rice powder that works wonder in brightening and clarifying skin right after use. I really love this mask. If I could use this everyday, I will! (but of course NOT since we can't exfoliate everyday)

avis.titre: This mask's formula is quite good
avis.texte: This mask's formula is quite good but the downside is the rice granules. If not gently applied and washed off, it can be abrasive to the skin. I love it but for the one downside, I give four stars.

avis.titre: I love how this can be nourishing for my skin.
avis.texte: 🌾𝐌𝐲 𝐓𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐬/𝐄𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞: I enjoyed using this scrub and mask in one. I love how this can be nourishing for my skin. I use this whenever my skin feels tight or dry when using some drying cleanser or just whenever I feel like using it. lol By the way, this is the new formulation. It's easy to apply using a silicon brush. The grains are not too harsh now because I read some reviews before that the grains of the old formula were too harsh and had some sharp rice hulls. Despite its new formulation, if you have extra sensitive skin, this may not be for you. I experienced a tingling sensation on both sides of my nose, which I found irritating because I wanted to scratch it out (but I didn't, don't worry) and I'm glad that it subsided in a few minutes. Overall, this is still a nice mask, but not for those with irritated skin. I love that this can be used as a physical exfoliant. Just be gentle with the scrubbing. This leaves my skin feeling so nourished and extra soft. 🌾𝐌𝐲 𝐑𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠: 🌕🌕🌕🌕🌑/5

avis.titre: The I'm From Rice Mask is fantastic for nourishing, smoothin
avis.texte: The I'm From Rice Mask is fantastic for nourishing, smoothing and brightening the complexion. The reformulated version has much smoother rice grain particles that don't feel harsh on the skin, giving more of a gentle exfoliation to remove dead skin cells. The mask base is a cream that is quite rich and fatty and sits nicely on top of the skin. It also washes off easily and leaves a light residue behind that slowly absorbs into the skin to keep it well moisturised. This mask is a must try for those with dry flaky skin and dull complexions looking for brightness and moisture.

avis.titre: It is a gentle exfoliant that removes dead skin cells and im
avis.texte: These have easily become my second-favorite mask from I'm From (next to Mugwort Mask). It is a gentle exfoliant that removes dead skin cells and impurities. It leaves your skin soft and nourished after use. I massaged this gently on my skin and boy, it didn't disappoint. It is also easy to wash off compared with other I'm From masks. I use this once a week because I still prefer to use BHA for exfoliation. 4/5, will repurchase.

avis.titre: So this is an exfoliating mask.
avis.texte: So this is an exfoliating mask. You apply the mask and massage it into your skin then let it sit for 10 minutes. You have to be very careful about how hard you are pushing on your skin because the rice hull bits can really sctatch up your skin. So I changed this up and applied the mask and let it sit for the 10 minutes, then I gently massaged my skin while I was removing the mask. I absolutely love the glow my skin has after using this mask. It is honestly incredible. My skin feels unbelievably soft and smooth.

avis.titre: I am obsessed with the I'm From wash off masks, but this one
avis.texte: I am obsessed with the I'm From wash off masks, but this one is for sure my favorite. It's gentle when you use it but it works so insanely well. Definitely a winner.

avis.titre: Live I'm from products!
avis.texte: Live I'm from products! This mask is good but very hard to wash off, because off the rice granules.

avis.titre: This mask leaves your skin soooo soft and gives a refreshed
avis.texte: This mask leaves your skin soooo soft and gives a refreshed look after using it!

avis.titre: This rice mask is very nourishing with varying sizes of grai
avis.texte: For someone with sensitive skin I generally prefer a good gentle physical exfoliation over chemical ones to avoid irritation. This rice mask is very nourishing with varying sizes of grains. I use this mask about once a week. I just leave it on the face for a while and when I am ready to wash it off, I'd wet my fingertips and do a few gentle circles on the face. Immediately after washing the mask off, my face looks brighter and oh so much smoother! This mask is my mom's favorite, she tried it once and took it from me. Sometimes the rice husk pieces can be bit too rough if you rub too hard.

avis.titre: This mask has natural scent which is not overpowering.
avis.texte: This mask has natural scent which is not overpowering. As you can see the texture, it is like a paste with bits of rice particles. As per instruction, I applied and massaged my face, left on for 10 minutes before rinsing off. During the massaging process, the bits of rice particles tend to scratch my skin. Because the bits of rice particles are uncook and hard, so there will be some sharp edges. From then on, I decided to massage on wet skin instead. Because originally the paste was sticky so when you massage it, its kinda rough plus the rice grains are hard. Applying it on wet skin is alot easier, easier to massage and its more gentle. I will focus on areas with clogged pores and blackheads. After rinsing off, my skin feels so clean, soft and smooth. It doesn't strip skin moisture or cause any irritations. My skin is moisturized, skin tone looks more even and brighter. This will be a great product if the rice particles isn't so rough. For first time users, please massage gently.

avis.titre: The rice husks are quite large, so be very gentle.
avis.texte: The rice husks are quite large, so be very gentle. This mask doesn't melt and run down my face or into my eyes. I leave this on for an hour or more in the evening and then follow with the I'm from honey mask and my skin is buttery and glowing by bedtime.

avis.titre: Once I wash this mask off, it leaves my skin feeling so smoo
avis.texte: I usually put this on just before I get in the bath, I do find the rice flakes off a tiny bit sometimes but it really doesnt bother me. Once I wash this mask off, it leaves my skin feeling so smooth and soft, im obsessed! I love that the rice acts as an exfoliant.

avis.titre: This is an exfoliating mask containing rice bran and rice po
avis.texte: This is an exfoliating mask containing rice bran and rice powder, which help to remove impurities from the skin, thereby restoring its natural glow. Also formulated with vitamins B1 and B2, and rice water, this mask helps tighten the skin and reduce the look of enlarged pores. I use this once a week, and as this is a physical exfoliator, I am careful to be gentle when massaging this into my skin. This mask leaves my skin looking brighter, and feeling super soft after use!

avis.titre: I love the texture of this mask, it is soft and smooth with
avis.texte: Contains a blend of Rice Bran and Rice powder. Which helps brighten and hydrate the skin. This mask also contains Vitamins and minerals to help shrink pores, rejuvenate the skin and improve elasticity. I love the texture of this mask, it is soft and smooth with exfoliating small pieces of rice grains. After using this mask my skin felt very hydrated, amazingly soft and left my skin looking much brighter.

avis.titre: This mask is super underrated in my opinion.
avis.texte: This mask is super underrated in my opinion. I apply it right after cleansing, before my face dries at all. I add a small dollop to my chin, forehead and s leach cheek, then start massaging it in and the chin, working my way up. You really just use your fingers to guide the mask without adding any pressure. This smooths my skin while making it feel super moisturized and nourished.

avis.titre: This is an amazing wash off mask that nourishes and exfoliat
avis.texte: This is an amazing wash off mask that nourishes and exfoliates at the same time. The texture is thick and has tiny bits of rice grains and rice bran to remove dead skin. It's so gentle on the skin and feels so creamy and buttery on the application. My skin felt extremely hydrated and moisturized. It gives an instant brightening effect too. It has a strong floral fragrance to it.

avis.titre: Application is easy and I prefer to gently massage it while
avis.texte: I was really hesitant with this mask thinking that it will be too harsh for my sensitive skin but I want to try all I'm From mask. This is more like a physical scrub so I only use it once a week or every two weeks depends on my skin. Application is easy and I prefer to gently massage it while washing it off especially on the areas I am prone to clogged pores. I like how soft my skin after using this.

avis.titre: This mask feels so nice.
avis.texte: This mask feels so nice. You just have to be sure to follow the instructions. Make sure your face is damp before use! It smells so good, always relaxes me and the thick creme element of the mask feels so good on my skin. Good exfoliating mask, but you have to be sure to be careful with it. The raw rice elements can easily become abrasive if you don't use it with care.

avis.texte: This one is new to me. I actually don't know how to do after I applied the spatula on my face because I was so confused how to spread it because of the texture. It has rice bran on it, so i was hesitant scrubbing it off my face. Fortunately, it just spread well because of its buttery texture too. This one is close to a physical exfoliant but this one leaves my skin smooth, soft and nourished after rinsing.

avis.titre: This leaves my skin feeling so smooth, soft, and refreshed.
avis.texte: This leaves my skin feeling so smooth, soft, and refreshed. I love the smell too. I apply it and leave it on for about 30 minutes before washing it off. Then, I go about my normal bedtime skin routine. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: I fell in love with this product the first time I used it.
avis.texte: I fell in love with this product the first time I used it. I feel my skin is so clean, glowing, tight and refresh. I hope you will have 1+1 & 50% offer very soon including the rice toner. I also love it since it is so mild and refreshing as well. Both products compliment each other for best results.

avis.titre: Very hydrated and it's so refreshing. Buying again 😁
avis.texte: I already figure the rice was good but it's way better than I thought. Very hydrated and it's so refreshing. Buying again 😁

avis.titre: I might have found my new face scrub
avis.texte: I might have found my new face scrub... I'M FROM Rice Mask shows what's inside. it's a paste with rice bran pieces that exfoliates the skin mechanically. I love the sweet but delicate scent and especially how my skin looks after: renew, firmer, smoother and glowy. Please, be careful and don't over-exfoliate. Once per week is ok, it's quite an intensive product and 2-in-1.

avis.titre: it is really gentle and moisturizing. Makes my skin plump an
avis.texte: I received this mask in Sharla's skincare box, and at first I was not really hyped for this, because a physical srub not always good for my dryish skin. But I was surprised. If you use it on wet skin (I use it in the shower after cleansing) it is really gentle and moisturizing. Makes my skin plump and even. So I can recommend but I highly recommend using on wet skin.

avis.titre: Overall this is an amazing mask and perfect for anyone looki
avis.texte: 🌟 Naturally contains vitamins B1 and B2 to brighten 🌾 Exfoliate gently with rice powder and bran Overall this is an amazing mask and perfect for anyone looking to smooth and soften gently with a neutral and non-irritating product. The rice powder is noticeable in texture but not irritating and the texture overall is still creamy and light. I found this to do a great job of both hydrating and smoothing, and my skin looked glowy and dewy after use. I think the texture could be a little finer in terms of abrasiveness but I do tend to have more sensitive skin.

avis.titre: this has got to be the gentlest way to do it. It's super sof
avis.texte: - A scrub and a mask in one - Made from rice from Yeoju province in Korea to gently exfoliate and brighten the skin (with actual bits of rice bran and powder in there!) - I'm always a little scared with physical exfoliation, but this has got to be the gentlest way to do it. It's super soft (rice pudding vibes) but creates just enough friction to remove dead skin. After using this, my face feels soft, moisturised and refreshed.
